# Draft:Asia-Pacific Sustainability Action Awards (APSAA)

The Asia-Pacific Sustainability Action Awards (APSAA), held annually by the Taiwan Institute for Sustainable Energy (TAISE), honor individuals and organizations that have made notable contributions to sustainable development. The awards feature several categories, such as the Changemaker Award, the Livable and Sustainable City Award, and recognitions for exceptional Chief Sustainability Officers. APSAA’s mission is to advance the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), increase awareness of sustainability efforts, and encourage regional cooperation throughout the Asia-Pacific, as stated by the TCSA.
